messages.subject: dispersion plot
parts:
Hi,

I'v been trying to visualize the distribution of words/tags/etc. in turns using the plot() function for a dummy dataframe with the same dimensions as my real dataframe with linguistic information and plotting the words/tags/etc. by using the text() function.

For example, the attached plot shows the distribution of nouns in a random 10-word-turn sample (n = 1,000) from the BNC.

Is there an established function in R for this type of visualization?

Best
Chris
